title: Godrej Properties — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Godrej Properties has launched several flagship projects including Godrej Astra in Gurugram, Godrej Regal Pavilion in Hyderabad, Godrej Trilogy in Mumbai, and its first plotted development in Panipat. The company has delivered close to 41 million sq ft of real estate since FY18 and is developing landmark projects in 12 cities across India. It has received numerous awards recognizing quality and safety, including CNBC-Awaaz Builder of the Year (2018) and Construction Week India's Real Estate Company of the Year (2018). In June 2026, it launched Godrej Vanantara in Bengaluru.

Godrej Properties' key differentiators compared to other Real Estate companies include geographical diversification, strong residential sales, project additions, and an asset-light approach in several developments. It focuses primarily on residential development across several major Indian property markets, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Pune, and Hyderabad. Godrej Properties also has a larger development footprint of over 200 million square feet compared to its competitors. However, it has a lower return on equity (ROE) and operating margin compared to Macrotech Developers Limited, which has superior capital productivity and customer retention among high-net-worth individuals.

Godrej Properties is more focused on development and has built its strategy around acquiring and developing projects across multiple cities.
